name: io.github.BrightbeamAI/brevet
title: Brevet
description: Change control for what AI agents learn: humans promote, releases are signed, rules can be recalled

environmentVariables.name: BREVET_HOME
environmentVariables.description: The Brevet workspace to serve: a folder holding agent.yaml and .brevet/. It is created on first use; run 'brevet init' there to write a starter manifest.

environmentVariables.name: BREVET_AUTO_CAPTURE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to have sessions record corrections without being asked. Leave unset to record only on request.
